items.title: Cloud computing
items.body: Cloud computing adalah penyediaan layanan komputasi lewat internet. Kamu menyewa server, storage, database, dan jaringan dari penyedia seperti Microsoft, bukan membeli hardware sendiri. Kebalikannya adalah on-premises: server milik sendiri di gedung sendiri, dibeli dan dirawat sendiri.
keyPoints: Cloud = layanan komputasi yang disewa lewat internet
Contohnya virtual machine (VM), yaitu server virtual, lalu storage, database, dan jaringan
On-premises = hardware sendiri di gedung sendiri
items.example: Toko online menyewa dua VM di Azure untuk websitenya dan membayar tagihan bulanan, tanpa membeli server.

items.prompt: Cloud computing is the delivery of computing services over the internet.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini benar. Compute, storage, networking, database, dan layanan lain disewa lewat internet, bukan dibangun sendiri di gedung kantor.

items.prompt: Which of these is an example of cloud computing?
options: Renting virtual machines from Azure and paying monthly
Buying a new server for the office server room
Installing an app from a removable drive
Printing reports on an office printer
items.explanation: Menyewa VM (Virtual Machine) di Azure dan bayar bulanan itu cloud. Membeli server untuk ruang server kantor itu on-premises: hardware milik dan urusanmu sendiri.

items.title: Kenapa pindah ke cloud
items.body: Di cloud, penyedia yang membeli dan merawat hardware datacenter. Kamu tinggal memakai layanannya. Resource baru bisa dibuat dalam hitungan menit, bukan menunggu server dikirim. Tapi cloud tidak gratis: kamu tetap membayar layanan yang dipakai.
keyPoints: Tidak perlu membeli dan merawat hardware sendiri
Resource bisa ditambah dalam hitungan menit
Cloud tetap berbayar, sesuai layanan yang dipakai

items.prompt: Which two are benefits of moving to cloud computing? Choose two.
options: No need to buy and maintain your own datacenter hardware
Resources can be added in minutes
All costs disappear
You must buy servers before you can start
items.explanation: Cloud menghapus kerepotan hardware dan mempercepat penambahan resource. Tapi biaya tetap ada (bayar sesuai pakai), dan akun serta identitas tetap tanggung jawabmu.

items.title: Consumption-based model
items.body: Di consumption-based model, kamu hanya membayar resource yang benar-benar dipakai. Tidak ada biaya di depan (upfront cost), yaitu uang yang harus keluar sebelum apa pun bisa dipakai, seperti membeli server. Karena itu, kebutuhan sementara cukup disewa selama dibutuhkan.
keyPoints: Bayar sesuai pemakaian (pay-as-you-go)
Tidak ada biaya di depan untuk hardware
Cocok untuk kebutuhan sementara atau yang naik-turun
items.trap: Consumption-based bukan berarti gratis. Biayanya tetap ada, hanya dibayar saat dipakai.

items.prompt: With a consumption-based model, you pay a large upfront fee before you can use any resources.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Consumption-based model tidak punya biaya di depan. Kamu bayar sesuai pemakaian, dan berhenti bayar saat resource tidak dipakai lagi.

items.prompt: Match each term with its meaning.
pairs: Renting computing services over the internet
Paying only for what you use
Running your own hardware in your own building
Money spent before anything can be used
items.explanation: Cloud mengganti biaya di depan (upfront cost) untuk hardware on-premises dengan tagihan sesuai pemakaian.

items.prompt: A startup runs a two-week marketing campaign and needs 20 extra servers only during that time. Which benefit of the consumption-based model helps most?
options: It pays for the extra servers only while it uses them
It gets the servers for free because the campaign is short
It must sign a three-year hardware contract
It must buy the servers first and resell them later
items.explanation: Server tambahan cukup dibuat selama kampanye, lalu dihapus. Bayarnya hanya selama dipakai, tanpa membeli hardware yang nanti menganggur.

items.title: Tambah atau hapus kapan saja
items.body: Beban kerja naik? Tambah resource kapan saja, dan kamu hanya membayar tambahannya. Beban turun atau proyek selesai? Hapus resource-nya. Begitu dihapus, resource itu tidak ditagih lagi.
keyPoints: Tambah resource saat dibutuhkan, bayar tambahannya saja
Resource dihapus, tagihannya berhenti
items.example: Tim uji coba menambah server selama pengujian besar, lalu menghapusnya setelah selesai. Tagihan bulan berikutnya turun lagi.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso moves its test environment to Azure and uses the consumption-based model.

statements.text: Contoso keeps paying for a virtual machine's compute time after deleting the virtual machine.
Contoso must pay for a full year of capacity up front.
Contoso can add more resources when the test workload grows.

items.explanation: Consumption-based artinya bayar sesuai pemakaian: tidak ada kontrak kapasitas di depan, resource bisa ditambah kapan saja, dan tagihan berhenti saat resource dihapus.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence.
items.sentence: Cloud computing is the delivery of computing services over the ___, and with a consumption-based model you pay only for what you ___.
items.explanation: Cloud = layanan komputasi lewat internet. Consumption-based = bayar sesuai pemakaian.

items.title: Shared responsibility
items.body: Di cloud, tanggung jawab keamanan dibagi antara kamu (customer) dan penyedia cloud. Microsoft selalu menjaga datacenter fisik, jaringan fisik, dan host fisik. Kamu selalu bertanggung jawab atas data, device yang dipakai, serta account dan identity. Sisanya tergantung jenis layanan: infrastruktur identitas, aplikasi, kontrol jaringan, dan sistem operasi. Sebagian bahkan dibagi dua, misalnya aplikasi dan kontrol jaringan di PaaS (Platform as a Service).
keyPoints: Selalu customer: data, device, account dan identity
Selalu Microsoft: datacenter, jaringan, dan host fisik
Tergantung jenis layanan: identitas, aplikasi, jaringan, sistem operasi
Sebagian dibagi, misalnya aplikasi di PaaS
items.trap: Pindah ke cloud tidak memindahkan tanggung jawab atas data dan akun ke Microsoft.

items.prompt: In the shared responsibility model, Microsoft is always responsible for the physical datacenter.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini benar. Gedung, listrik, pendingin, dan keamanan fisik datacenter selalu urusan Microsoft, apa pun jenis layanannya.

items.prompt: Sort each item by who is responsible for it.
items.explanation: Hafalkan polanya: data, device, serta account dan identity selalu milik customer. Datacenter, jaringan, dan host fisik selalu milik Microsoft. Sisanya, seperti OS (Operating System), kontrol jaringan, dan aplikasi, tergantung jenis layanan.

items.prompt: A company is comparing IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), PaaS (Platform as a Service), and SaaS (Software as a Service). Which two responsibilities change depending on the service type? Choose two.
options: Information and data
Network controls
Operating system
Physical datacenter
items.explanation: Kontrol jaringan dan sistem operasi tergantung jenis layanan. Data selalu tanggung jawab customer, dan datacenter fisik selalu tanggung jawab Microsoft.

items.title: IaaS, PaaS, dan SaaS
items.body: Pembagian tugas bergeser sesuai jenis layanan. Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), kamu menyewa VM (Virtual Machine) dan mengurus sistem operasi, kontrol jaringan, serta aplikasinya sendiri. Di PaaS (Platform as a Service), penyedia mengurus sistem operasi, sedangkan aplikasi dan kontrol jaringan diurus bersama. Di SaaS (Software as a Service), kamu tinggal memakai aplikasi jadi seperti Microsoft 365.
keyPoints: IaaS: sistem operasi urusanmu
PaaS: sistem operasi urusan penyedia, aplikasi dibagi
SaaS: aplikasi jadi, contohnya Microsoft 365
Di ketiganya, data dan akun tetap urusanmu
items.trap: Makin ke arah SaaS, makin sedikit yang kamu urus. Tapi data dan akun tidak pernah pindah ke Microsoft.

items.prompt: When you use a SaaS (Software as a Service) app such as Microsoft 365, Microsoft becomes responsible for your data.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Di semua jenis layanan, termasuk SaaS (Software as a Service), kamu tetap bertanggung jawab atas data, device, serta account dan identity.

items.prompt: Which responsibility stays with the customer for every cloud service type: IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), PaaS (Platform as a Service), and SaaS (Software as a Service)?
options: Information and data
Physical hosts
Operating system patching
Physical network
items.explanation: Data selalu milikmu di semua model layanan. Patching OS (Operating System) cuma jadi tugasmu di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service).

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: A company runs its website on an Azure virtual machine, which is IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service).

statements.text: The company is responsible for installing operating system updates on the virtual machine.
The company is responsible for replacing failed disks in the physical server.
Microsoft is responsible for the company's user accounts.

items.explanation: Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), OS (Operating System) di dalam VM (Virtual Machine) adalah urusanmu. Server fisik, termasuk disk-nya, urusan Microsoft. Akun pengguna selalu urusanmu.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso plans to move its web app from Azure virtual machines to a PaaS (Platform as a Service) service in Azure.

statements.text: Microsoft becomes responsible for the operating system that runs the app.
Contoso and Microsoft share responsibility for the network controls of the app.
Microsoft becomes responsible for the user accounts of Contoso.

items.explanation: Di PaaS (Platform as a Service), sistem operasi diurus Microsoft, sedangkan aplikasi, kontrol jaringan, dan infrastruktur identitas dibagi. Akun pengguna selalu tanggung jawab customer.

items.title: Mengamankan akun itu tugasmu
items.body: Karena account dan identity selalu milik customer, kamu yang harus mengamankannya. Kalau password bocor, reset password-nya dan wajibkan MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication). MFA meminta bukti tambahan saat login, misalnya kode dari aplikasi di ponsel, jadi password saja tidak cukup untuk masuk. Microsoft menyediakan alatnya, tapi kamu yang memakainya.
keyPoints: Password bocor: reset, lalu wajibkan MFA
MFA = password plus bukti lain, misalnya kode di ponsel
Microsoft menyediakan alat, customer yang memakainya

items.prompt: An employee's password is stolen and used to sign in to your company's Azure subscription. Under the shared responsibility model, who is responsible for protecting that account?
options: Your company
Microsoft
The internet service provider
Nobody, because it is a cloud account
items.explanation: Account dan identity selalu tanggung jawab customer. Makanya MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) dan password yang kuat itu tugasmu; Microsoft menyediakan alatnya.

items.prompt: What should you do?

scene.title: Risky sign-in detected
scene.message: A user account signed in from an unfamiliar country. Review the sign-in and secure the account.

options: Reset the user's password and require MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication)
Open a support ticket so Microsoft secures the account for you
Ignore it, because Microsoft is responsible for identities
Wait for Microsoft to send the user a new password
items.explanation: Account dan identity itu tanggung jawab customer. Kamu yang harus reset password dan mewajibkan MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication); Microsoft menyediakan alatnya.

items.prompt: Complete the rule.
items.sentence: The customer is always responsible for data, ___, and accounts and ___.
items.explanation: Tiga hal yang selalu milik customer: data, device, serta account dan identity.

items.title: Public cloud dan private cloud
items.body: Public cloud dibangun dan dikelola penyedia seperti Microsoft, lalu dipakai bersama banyak pelanggan lewat internet. Tidak ada pembelian hardware di depan, dan kamu bayar sesuai pemakaian. Private cloud dipakai satu organisasi saja, di datacenter sendiri atau di penyedia. Kontrolnya penuh, tapi hardware dan perawatannya ditanggung sendiri.
keyPoints: Public: milik penyedia, dipakai bersama, tanpa beli hardware
Private: satu organisasi, kontrol penuh
Private: beli dan rawat hardware sendiri

items.prompt: In a public cloud, you must buy the servers before you can deploy an app.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Di public cloud tidak ada belanja hardware di depan. Resource bisa dibuat dalam hitungan menit dan dibayar sesuai pemakaian.

items.prompt: A private cloud is shared by many different organizations.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Private cloud khusus untuk satu organisasi, jadi kontrolnya penuh. Cloud yang dipakai bersama banyak organisasi adalah public cloud.

items.prompt: Which two are characteristics of a private cloud? Choose two.
options: The organization has complete control over the resources
The organization is responsible for buying and maintaining hardware
Resources are shared with many other customers
There is never any upfront cost
items.explanation: Private cloud = kontrol penuh, tapi beli dan rawat hardware sendiri. Berbagi dengan banyak pelanggan dan tanpa biaya di depan itu ciri public cloud.

items.prompt: A company wants no upfront hardware cost and wants to add servers within minutes during busy seasons. No regulation requires on-premises hosting. Which cloud model fits best?
options: Public cloud
Private cloud
On-premises only
A new private datacenter
items.explanation: Tanpa biaya hardware di depan dan bisa scale cepat: itu kekuatan public cloud. Private cloud butuh beli hardware sendiri.

items.title: Hybrid cloud
items.body: Hybrid cloud menggabungkan public cloud dengan private cloud atau on-premises yang saling terhubung. Organisasi bebas memilih workload mana yang tetap di tempat sendiri dan mana yang pindah ke public cloud. Tidak semuanya harus dipindahkan.
keyPoints: Hybrid = public cloud + lingkungan sendiri, saling terhubung
Kamu yang memilih workload mana jalan di mana
items.example: Bank menyimpan data yang diatur regulasi di datacenter sendiri, tapi menjalankan website promosinya di public cloud.

items.prompt: Which cloud model connects a private cloud or on-premises datacenter with a public cloud?
options: Hybrid cloud
Public cloud
Private cloud
On-premises only
items.explanation: Hybrid = gabungan public cloud dengan private cloud atau on-premises yang saling terhubung.

items.prompt: Match each cloud model with its description.
pairs: Provider-owned infrastructure shared by many customers
Used by one organization, which maintains the hardware
Public and private environments connected together
Your own hardware in your own building, no cloud model
items.explanation: Public: milik penyedia, dipakai bersama. Private: satu organisasi. Hybrid: keduanya terhubung. On-premises: hardware sendiri tanpa model cloud.

items.prompt: A bank must keep regulated data in its own datacenter, but its promotion website has big traffic spikes. Place each workload.
items.explanation: Inilah hybrid cloud: data yang diatur regulasi tetap on-premises, sedangkan beban yang naik-turun dan sementara pindah ke public cloud.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Fabrikam keeps some apps in its own datacenter and runs other apps in Azure, and the two environments are connected.

statements.text: Fabrikam is using a hybrid cloud.
Fabrikam must move every app to Azure to use a hybrid cloud.
Apps in Fabrikam's datacenter cannot communicate with apps in Azure.

items.explanation: Hybrid memberi fleksibilitas: kamu yang menentukan workload mana di on-premises dan mana di cloud, dan kedua lingkungan saling terhubung. Tidak perlu memindahkan semuanya.

items.title: Multi-cloud
items.body: Multi-cloud berarti memakai lebih dari satu penyedia public cloud sekaligus, misalnya Azure dan penyedia lain. Ini sering terjadi setelah dua perusahaan bergabung. Tantangannya adalah mengelola beberapa lingkungan yang berbeda, dan Azure Arc membantu mengelolanya dari satu tempat.
keyPoints: Multi-cloud = dua atau lebih penyedia public cloud
Azure Arc membantu mengelola resource di luar Azure
items.trap: Jangan tertukar: hybrid = public cloud + lingkungan milik sendiri, multi-cloud = beberapa penyedia public cloud.

items.prompt: A multi-cloud environment uses more than one public cloud provider.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini benar. Contohnya sebagian layanan di Azure dan sebagian di penyedia cloud lain. Azure Arc bisa membantu mengelolanya dari satu tempat.

items.prompt: Match each cloud model with its description.
pairs: Two or more public cloud providers
Public cloud connected to your own datacenter
Shared provider infrastructure, pay per use
items.explanation: Multi-cloud = beberapa penyedia public cloud. Hybrid = public cloud plus lingkungan privat yang terhubung.

items.prompt: After a merger, a company runs workloads in Azure and in another public cloud provider. Which term describes this?
options: Multi-cloud
Private cloud
On-premises
Hybrid cloud
items.explanation: Dua penyedia public cloud sekaligus = multi-cloud.

items.title: CapEx dan OpEx
items.body: CapEx (Capital Expenditure) adalah belanja besar di depan untuk aset fisik, misalnya membeli server atau membangun ruang server. Nilai aset itu menyusut dari waktu ke waktu. OpEx (Operational Expenditure) adalah biaya berjalan: kamu membayar layanan saat dipakai, dan jumlahnya bisa naik-turun tiap bulan.
keyPoints: CapEx: beli aset fisik di depan, nilainya menyusut
OpEx: bayar layanan saat dipakai, bisa naik-turun

items.prompt: Which is an example of CapEx (Capital Expenditure)?
options: Buying storage arrays for an on-premises datacenter
Paying a monthly Azure bill
Paying per hour for an Azure virtual machine
Paying for the storage you used last month
items.explanation: Membeli aset fisik di depan = CapEx (Capital Expenditure). Semua tagihan cloud yang dibayar sesuai pemakaian = OpEx (Operational Expenditure).

items.prompt: Sort each cost as CapEx (Capital Expenditure) or OpEx (Operational Expenditure).

items.text: Buying servers for a new datacenter
Paying for extra storage only in the months you need it

items.explanation: CapEx (Capital Expenditure) = membeli aset fisik di depan, nilainya menyusut dari waktu ke waktu. OpEx (Operational Expenditure) = membayar layanan saat dipakai, termasuk tagihan cloud.

items.prompt: Which two statements describe OpEx (Operational Expenditure)? Choose two.
options: You pay for services as you use them
Costs can go up or down from month to month
You pay a large amount up front for physical assets
The value of the assets goes down over time through depreciation
items.explanation: OpEx (Operational Expenditure) dibayar saat dipakai dan bisa naik-turun. Belanja besar di depan dan penyusutan nilai aset itu ciri CapEx (Capital Expenditure).

items.title: Cloud menggeser CapEx ke OpEx
items.body: Tagihan cloud termasuk OpEx (Operational Expenditure). Jadi saat perusahaan menutup ruang servernya dan pindah ke Azure, belanja CapEx (Capital Expenditure) untuk hardware turun dan diganti tagihan pemakaian. Server fisik Azure tetap milik Microsoft, bukan dibeli customer.
keyPoints: Pindah ke cloud: CapEx turun, OpEx naik
Tagihan cloud bulanan = OpEx
items.trap: Arahnya selalu dari CapEx ke OpEx, bukan sebaliknya.

items.prompt: Moving from your own datacenter to Azure usually shifts spending from OpEx (Operational Expenditure) to CapEx (Capital Expenditure).
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Arahnya terbalik. Kamu berhenti membeli server di depan (CapEx (Capital Expenditure)) dan beralih ke tagihan bulanan sesuai pemakaian (OpEx (Operational Expenditure)).

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Tailwind Traders plans to close its server room and run all of its servers in Azure.

statements.text: Tailwind Traders will increase its capital expenditure on server hardware.
Tailwind Traders will pay for Azure services as an operational expense.
Tailwind Traders must buy the Azure servers it uses.

items.explanation: Pindah ke Azure = belanja hardware (CapEx (Capital Expenditure)) turun, diganti tagihan pemakaian (OpEx (Operational Expenditure)). Server fisik Azure tetap milik Microsoft.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence about CapEx (Capital Expenditure) and OpEx (Operational Expenditure).
items.sentence: Buying servers up front is ___, while paying a monthly cloud bill based on usage is ___.
items.explanation: Beli di depan = CapEx (Capital Expenditure). Bayar sesuai pemakaian = OpEx (Operational Expenditure).

items.prompt: A company needs to explain cloud computing to its managers before a migration project. Which definition should it use?
options: Running every server in the company's own building and maintaining the hardware itself
Buying servers from a vendor and installing them in an on-premises server room
Keeping all company files on the laptops of the employees who use them
Delivering computing services, such as servers, storage, and databases, over the internet
items.explanation: Cloud computing adalah penyediaan layanan komputasi lewat internet: server, storage, database, networking, dan software. Menjalankan dan merawat hardware sendiri di gedung sendiri adalah on-premises.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso plans to move its file server and its database from its server room to Azure.

statements.text: Contoso will still pay for the Azure services it uses.
Contoso must buy the physical servers that host its Azure resources.
Contoso can create new resources in minutes when it needs them.

items.explanation: Cloud tidak gratis: Contoso membayar layanan yang dipakainya. Hardware datacenter dibeli dan dirawat penyedia cloud, dan resource baru bisa dibuat dalam hitungan menit.

items.prompt: A company plans to move several workloads to the cloud. Match each need with the cloud service that meets it.
pairs: Run a server without buying hardware
items.explanation: Contoh layanan cloud: virtual machine (server virtual), storage untuk menyimpan data, database, dan jaringan untuk menghubungkan resource.

items.prompt: A company deploys its web app to a PaaS (Platform as a Service) hosting service in Azure. Who installs operating system updates on the servers that run the app?
options: Microsoft
The company
The company's internet service provider
The people who use the app
items.explanation: Di PaaS (Platform as a Service), penyedia mengurus sistem operasi dan platform, sedangkan customer fokus ke aplikasi dan data. Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), update sistem operasi tetap tugas customer.

items.prompt: A company compares two options: buying servers for its own datacenter, or running the same workloads in Azure. Which statement describes the Azure option?
options: The costs are a capital expense paid up front for hardware
The costs are an operational expense that changes with usage
The company owns the hardware and records its depreciation each year
The company pays nothing until the hardware wears out
items.explanation: Tagihan cloud termasuk OpEx (Operational Expenditure): biaya berjalan yang dibayar saat dipakai dan bisa naik-turun. Membeli server sendiri adalah CapEx (Capital Expenditure), yaitu belanja besar di depan untuk aset yang nilainya menyusut.

items.prompt: The developers at a company need a test database for one afternoon. Which characteristic of cloud computing lets them do this without buying hardware?
options: Cloud services are free when they are used for less than a day
Resources can be created and released quickly, as needed
The company owns part of the cloud provider's hardware after it signs up
The cloud provider ships a server to the office for each new request
items.explanation: Resource cloud bisa dibuat dan dilepas dalam hitungan menit, dan hardware-nya diurus penyedia. Cloud tetap tidak gratis: database itu ditagih selama dipakai.

items.prompt: A company must keep full control over the hardware that runs its workloads. It can afford to buy and maintain that hardware. Which cloud model fits this requirement best?
options: Private cloud
Public cloud
Multi-cloud with two public providers
A consumption-based public service
items.explanation: Private cloud dipakai satu organisasi dan memberi kontrol penuh, tapi organisasi menanggung pembelian dan perawatan hardware-nya. Di public cloud dan multi-cloud, hardware milik penyedia.

items.prompt: A company creates a test environment in Azure for each new release and deletes the environment when testing ends. Under the consumption-based model, what happens to the cost of a deleted test environment?
options: The company stops paying for it
The company keeps paying for it until the end of the year
The company pays a deletion fee equal to one year of use
The company must buy the hardware it used during testing
items.explanation: Di consumption-based model, customer hanya membayar resource yang dipakai. Resource yang dihapus tidak ditagih lagi, dan tidak ada pembelian hardware.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: A startup plans to launch its app on Azure with the consumption-based model.

statements.text: The startup needs a large upfront payment for infrastructure before it can start.
If the app gets more users, the startup can add resources and pay only for what it adds.
The startup's Azure costs are capital expenditure.

items.explanation: Consumption-based model tidak butuh biaya di depan, dan resource bisa ditambah kapan saja dengan membayar tambahannya saja. Biaya cloud termasuk OpEx (Operational Expenditure), bukan CapEx (Capital Expenditure).

items.prompt: A company moves an on-premises app to Azure virtual machines, which is IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service). Which two responsibilities stay with the company? Choose two.
options: Replacing failed disks in the physical servers
Securing the physical datacenter buildings
Managing the user accounts that sign in to the app
Installing operating system updates on the virtual machines
items.explanation: Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), customer mengurus sistem operasi, aplikasi, dan data, dan akun selalu tanggung jawab customer. Disk fisik dan gedung datacenter selalu tanggung jawab Microsoft.

items.prompt: A company runs workloads in Azure and in another public cloud provider. It wants to manage the resources in both clouds from one place. What should it use?
options: Azure Arc
A private cloud for each provider
On-premises servers only
A larger upfront hardware purchase
items.explanation: Memakai lebih dari satu penyedia public cloud disebut multi-cloud. Azure Arc membantu mengelola resource di luar Azure, termasuk di cloud lain, dari satu tempat.

items.prompt: Users at a company sign in to cloud apps with only a password. The company wants to reduce the risk of stolen passwords being used. Under the shared responsibility model, what should the company do?
options: Wait for Microsoft to protect the accounts, because Microsoft owns the identities
Require MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) for its users, because protecting accounts is the customer's job
Nothing, because cloud providers are responsible for every sign-in
Ask its internet service provider to block password theft
items.explanation: Akun dan identity selalu tanggung jawab customer. Microsoft menyediakan alatnya, misalnya MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication), tapi customer yang harus mengaktifkan dan mewajibkannya.

facts.statement: Cloud computing adalah penyediaan layanan komputasi lewat internet, seperti server, storage, database, networking, dan software.
Contoh layanan cloud: virtual machine (server virtual), storage untuk menyimpan data, database, dan jaringan.
On-premises berarti menjalankan hardware milik sendiri di gedung atau datacenter sendiri, dengan pembelian dan perawatan ditanggung sendiri.
Dengan cloud, customer tidak perlu membeli dan merawat hardware datacenter sendiri; penyedia cloud yang mengurusnya.
Resource cloud bisa dibuat dan dilepas dengan cepat, dalam hitungan menit, sesuai kebutuhan.
Cloud tidak gratis: customer tetap membayar layanan yang dipakainya.
Di consumption-based model (pay-as-you-go), customer hanya membayar resource yang dipakai.
Consumption-based model tidak membutuhkan biaya di depan untuk membeli infrastruktur.
Biaya di depan (upfront cost) adalah uang yang dikeluarkan sebelum sesuatu bisa dipakai, misalnya membeli server.
Resource yang dihapus tidak ditagih lagi, jadi customer berhenti membayar resource yang sudah tidak dibutuhkan.
Saat butuh lebih, customer bisa menambah resource kapan saja dan hanya membayar tambahannya.
Di cloud, tanggung jawab keamanan dibagi antara penyedia cloud dan customer (shared responsibility model).
Customer selalu bertanggung jawab atas informasi dan data, device yang dipakai untuk mengakses cloud, serta account dan identity, apa pun jenis layanannya.
Untuk layanan cloud-nya, Microsoft selalu bertanggung jawab atas datacenter fisik, jaringan fisik, dan host fisik.

Tanggung jawab atas infrastruktur identitas dan direktori, aplikasi, kontrol jaringan, dan sistem operasi tergantung jenis layanan (IaaS, PaaS, atau SaaS). Sebagian dibagi antara customer dan Microsoft, misalnya aplikasi dan kontrol jaringan di PaaS.
Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), customer mengurus sistem operasi, kontrol jaringan, aplikasi, dan data di virtual machine sewaannya; Microsoft mengurus host, jaringan, dan datacenter fisik.

Di PaaS (Platform as a Service), Microsoft mengurus sistem operasi dan platform; aplikasi, kontrol jaringan, serta infrastruktur identitas dibagi antara customer dan Microsoft, dan data serta akun tetap tanggung jawab customer.

Di SaaS (Software as a Service), Microsoft menjalankan aplikasi jadi, misalnya Microsoft 365, termasuk kontrol jaringan dan sistem operasinya; infrastruktur identitas dibagi, dan data, device, serta akun tetap tanggung jawab customer.
Karena akun milik customer, customer yang mengamankannya, misalnya mereset password yang bocor dan mewajibkan MFA; Microsoft menyediakan alatnya.
MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) meminta bukti tambahan saat login, misalnya kode dari aplikasi di ponsel selain password.
Public cloud dibangun dan dikelola penyedia seperti Microsoft, lalu dipakai bersama banyak pelanggan lewat internet.
Di public cloud tidak ada pembelian hardware di depan; resource dibuat cepat dan dibayar sesuai pemakaian.
Private cloud dipakai oleh satu organisasi saja, bisa di datacenter sendiri atau di datacenter penyedia.
Private cloud memberi kontrol penuh, tapi organisasi menanggung pembelian dan perawatan hardware-nya.
Hybrid cloud menggabungkan public cloud dengan private cloud atau on-premises yang saling terhubung.
Di hybrid cloud, organisasi memilih workload mana yang berjalan di on-premises dan mana di public cloud; tidak semuanya harus dipindah.
Multi-cloud berarti memakai lebih dari satu penyedia public cloud sekaligus.
Tantangan multi-cloud adalah mengelola beberapa lingkungan berbeda; Azure Arc membantu mengelola resource di luar Azure dari satu tempat.
CapEx (Capital Expenditure) adalah belanja besar di depan untuk aset fisik seperti server atau gedung, yang nilainya menyusut dari waktu ke waktu.
OpEx (Operational Expenditure) adalah biaya berjalan untuk layanan yang dibayar saat dipakai, dan jumlahnya bisa naik-turun tiap bulan.
Tagihan cloud termasuk OpEx; pindah ke cloud menggeser belanja dari CapEx ke OpEx.
